experiment_template.research_question: Does real measured history pressure exercise safe recycling and recovery?
stop_conditions: No retry or redispatch of started trial.
Source or fixture drift blocks execution.
Stop after two trials even on failure.

success_criteria.pressure: at least one recycle, confirmed archive recovery, semantic pass, all dispatch projected bounds <=16384

falsifier: Pressure does not cause a recycle, any dispatch exceeds the hard bound, archive recovery is not confirmed, or the hidden repair check fails.
mechanism: A synthetic high-token inventory expands read history; the existing recycler can remove old observations and require archive recovery before final submission.
scope: Successor after zero-call harness failure caused by missing compiled-agent adapter. No H9 provider trial had executed. Prospective two-trial mechanism probe at 8K, baseline then pressure; synthetic load, known task, no efficacy or generalization claim.
statement: Adding bounded inspected history can exercise real-tokenizer context recycling at 8K while preserving a correct repair and verified archive recovery.
